"Bootleg First Generation." Her assessment.

"Wrong version." Another jab.

"Weird." Her final verdict.

But then there was NO24.

"Ice cream. Lots. Free." NO24 replied.

"Their special flavors. Chili peppers. Pickles."

"Interesting," NO24 said.

U.Icy began to suspect she'd truly met her match.

Especially that alternate version of Icy.
